API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIDNS GatewayEc DNS Gateway Z Resource Add DNS Gateway
Ec DNS Gateway Z Resource Add DNS Gateway
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/dnsGateways

Creates a new DNS gateway based on the specified parameters.

⚠ This API endpoint is accessible only via OneAPI.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
dnsGatewayType
string

Specifies the type of DNS gateway.

Possible values: [OFW_PDNS_REDIR_GW, EC_DNS_GW]

ecDnsGatewayOptionsPrimary
string

Specifies the primary DNS server for EC DNS gateway.

Possible values: [LAN_PRI_DNS_AS_PRI, LAN_SEC_DNS_AS_PRI, WAN_PRI_DNS_AS_PRI]

ecDnsGatewayOptionsSecondary
string

Specifies the secondary DNS server for EC DNS gateway.

Possible values: [LAN_PRI_DNS_AS_SEC, LAN_SEC_DNS_AS_SEC, WAN_SEC_DNS_AS_SEC]

failureBehavior
string

Specifies the failure behavior if the DNS server is unreachable.

Possible values: [FAIL_RET_ERR, FAIL_ALLOW_IGNORE_DNAT, FAIL_FORWARD_TO_ZTR]

id
int32

ID of the DNS gateway.

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the DNS gateway was last modified.

name
string

Name of the DNS gateway.

primaryIp
string

The primary IP address of the DNS gateway.

secondaryIp
string

The secondary IP address of the DNS gateway.

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
